A strategy to achieve pervoxel features that match similar structures throughout the whole volume by merging features from multiple slicing directions (X, Y, Z) [S2].

The source explicitly states that the approach employs a '2D → 3D merging strategy' to achieve 'pervoxel features that match similar structures throughout the whole volume.' The claim's mention of 'X, Y, Z' directions is consistent with the standard interpretation of merging multiple slicing directions in this context, as opposed to the single 'Z' direction criticized in the text.
